calls.reason: Only two provider announcements (AWS P5en, CoreWeave CKS) are in the packet; neither measures what drives customer selection, so commoditization is neither shown nor refuted.
CoreWeave filings imply about $728M paid on DDTL 1.0 in 2025, below $1bn, but the claim was hedged as 'not unreasonable to expect', which is not a callable firm forecast.
The IPO raised about $1.46bn for CoreWeave, not $4bn, but the loan-payment part is unresolved: the Q3 10-Q schedules $575M of total-debt principal for Q4 2025 without isolating loans.
The prospectus shows 96% of CoreWeave's 2024 revenue was committed contracts, but there is no market-wide data on hourly compute revenue from ordinary companies.
Core Scientific publicly said in June 2024 that 16 MW of HPC capacity was running for CoreWeave, and it reported $24.3M of HPC hosting revenue, so public proof of real capacity existed.
Product-market fit has no measurable test here. Ramp retention and Menlo survey data show real paid adoption but do not settle it or CoreWeave's growth dependence.
